name: @loom/tool-search-mcp-menu
description: An agent facing a 64-tool MCP catalogue that must not be in the prompt: agentLoop$({ toolSearch, skillActivation }) offers search_tools instead; host annotations close the vocabulary gap ("bill the customer" finds charge_invoice alone, the built-in ranker drops query stopwords), remote descriptions are withheld and results tainted, skills are discovered through search and activated mid-loop, a custom ranker factory is built from the sanitized search docs and runs in two-ranker mode, and a resume after a crash makes zero factory calls, zero ranker calls and zero repeat MCP calls. Offline, scripted model.
